output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is also not safe, allowing the owner to set the total supply of the token to be arbitrarily high.
The transferFrom function allows a spender to transfer funds to their own address, allowing a spender to steal funds.
The approve function uses a constant 'value' as the allowance, allowing attackers to exploit it in real world.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing attackers to steal funds.
The transfer function has a typo in it, allowing attackers to exploit it in real world.
